text:
Situation: Doxycycline hyclate 100 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 479 capsules (29.8 days at 16.1 per day). Corvale General holds 449 capsules (30.1 days at 14.9 per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 50 capsules (18.7 days at 2.7 per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows doxycycline hyclate is not listed as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly 30 days at East and General and 19 days at Lakeside. No shortage is declared by FDA. Supply continuity depends on securing a reliable vendor.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place initial order with AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. (ranked option 1); requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. (option 2) as backup; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (option 3) as backup; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (option 4) as backup; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC (option 5) as backup; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
